raids.description: The Dreamrift exists deep within the Rift of Aln, where the dreams of Aln'hara took form long ago. Dark manifestations have grown within the rift in Aln'hara's absence, devouring each other in an endless cycle. Even the brave haranir dare not delve too deep, for now something greater and more terrible lurks within the Dreamrift's depths.

raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: From high above the Voidstorm, Xal'atath has gathered the Devouring Host beneath her dark banner. raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Deep in the fungal valleys of Harandar, the fungarian sporecallers have been growing a new threat for The Grudge Pit. Shaded by towering mushrooms, Sporefall is the perfect site to empower their new creation.

raids.title: Sporefall
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Guided by the dark whispers of Malacrass, Zul'jan has freed the forgotten broods of Ula'tek from their prison. raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Hidden beneath the Vaults of Atal'Utek, Kith'ix was bound in his subterranean lair. With the defeat of Ula'tek, the restraints keeping Kith'ix at bay have weakened, unleashing the monstrosity the Amani locked away so long ago.

classTalents.name: Lighter Than Air

classTalents.description:
You gain a bonus effect based on your current health.

Above 90% health: Movement speed increased by 5%. This bonus stacks with similar effects.

Between 90% and 35% health: Damage taken reduced by 5%.

Below 35% health: Healing received increased by 10%.

classTalents.description: After you use Transcendence: Transfer, you can use Transcendence: Transfer again within 10 sec, ignoring its cooldown.
classTalents.name: Escape from Reality

heroTalents.description: Haste increased by 5%.
heroTalents.name: Veteran's Eye

heroTalents.description: Flurry Strikes deal 3,529 Nature damage to all enemies within 6 yds, reduced beyond 8 targets.

Auto attack critical strikes generate double the amount of Flurry Charges.


Keg Smash damage increased by 35%.

specTalents.name: Fists of Fury

specTalents.description:
Fists of Fury's damage is increased by 100% of your haste and Fists of Fury does 10% more damage each time it deals damage, resetting when Fists of Fury ends.

Your auto attack speed is increased by 60% for 8 sec after Fists of Fury ends.
specTalents.name: Momentum Boost

specTalents.description:
While out of combat, your Chi balances to 2 instead of depleting to empty.

Your stamina is increased by 5% and every 15 sec, your next Tiger Palm also casts Expel Harm.

 Expel Harm
Expel negative chi from your body, healing for 27,523 and dealing 25% of the amount healed as Nature damage to an enemy within 20 yards.
specTalents.name: Combat Wisdom

specTalents.description: Blackout Kick reduces the cooldown of Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury by 1.0 sec.
specTalents.name: Sharp Reflexes

specTalents.description: Tiger Palm damage increased by 50%.

specTalents.description: Increases your maximum Chi by 1, maximum Energy by 20, and your Energy regeneration by 10%.
specTalents.name: Ascension

specTalents.description: Your auto attacks have a 30% chance to instead kick your target dealing 37,593 Physical damage. Damage increased while using a two-handed weapon.
specTalents.name: Dual Threat

specTalents.description:
Tiger Palm causes your next Blackout Kick to strike an additional time dealing 8,453 Physical damage, stacking up to 4.

Blackout Kick has a 20% chance to reset the remaining cooldown on Rising Sun Kick.

specTalents.description: Rising Sun Kick has a chance equal to 100% of your haste to trigger a second time, dealing 9,301 Physical damage and restoring 1 Chi.

Rushing Wind Kick:
Kick up a powerful gust of wind, dealing 34,777 Nature damage in a 25 yd cone to enemies in front of you, split evenly among them. Damage is increased by 6% for each target hit, up to 30%.

Heals up to 5 allies affected by your heal over time effects for 31,829.
specTalents.name: Rushing Wind Kick

specTalents.description:
Rising Sun Kick critical strikes reduce the cooldown of Fists of Fury by 4 sec.

Spinning Crane Kick reduces the cooldown of Fists of Fury by 0.5 sec for each unique target struck, up to 2.5 sec.

The critical strike chance of Rising Sun Kick is increased by 20%.

specTalents.description: Your damage during Zenith is increased by 5%.
specTalents.name: Weapon of Wind

specTalents.description:
Rising Sun Kick's critical strike chance is increased by 4% for each nearby enemy, up to 5 enemies.

10% of Rising Sun Kick's damage splashes onto nearby enemies. Damage is reduced beyond 5 targets.
specTalents.name: Skyfire Heel

pvpTalents.name: Grapple Weapon

raids.description: The Dreamrift exists deep within the Rift of Aln, where the dreams of Aln'hara took form long ago. Dark manifestations have grown within the rift in Aln'hara's absence, devouring each other in an endless cycle. Even the brave haranir dare not delve too deep, for now something greater and more terrible lurks within the Dreamrift's depths.
raids.name: The Dreamrift
raids.title: The Dreamrift
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: From high above the Voidstorm, Xal'atath has gathered the Devouring Host beneath her dark banner. The towering Voidspire looms like a spear of darkness, a citadel guarded by an army of the void. The forces of the light - led by Alleria Windrunner and the Champions of Azeroth - must rally for one last desperate assault before all is lost.
raids.name: The Voidspire
raids.title: The Voidspire
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Darkness has eclipsed the Isle of Quel'Danas, clouding the skies above Silvermoon City. With Arator the Redeemer by their side, the Champions of Azeroth must march on the Sunwell before the light of the blood elves is lost forever.
raids.name: March on Quel'Danas
raids.title: March on Quel'Danas
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Deep in the fungal valleys of Harandar, the fungarian sporecallers have been growing a new threat for The Grudge Pit. Shaded by towering mushrooms, Sporefall is the perfect site to empower their new creation.
raids.name: Sporefall
raids.title: Sporefall
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Guided by the dark whispers of Malacrass, Zul'jan has freed the forgotten broods of Ula'tek from their prison. As the monster's power grows, Zul'jarra calls upon the Champions of Azeroth to descend into the Vaults of Atal'Utek to stop her brother before the weapon is unleashed upon Azeroth.
raids.name: The Venomous Abyss
raids.title: The Venomous Abyss
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Hidden beneath the Vaults of Atal'Utek, Kith'ix was bound in his subterranean lair. With the defeat of Ula'tek, the restraints keeping Kith'ix at bay have weakened, unleashing the monstrosity the Amani locked away so long ago.
raids.name: The Unbinding of Kith'ix
raids.title: The Unbinding of Kith'ix
raids.subtitle: Level 90

bossEncounters.description: This ravenous hydra has survived this cursed place through scavenging the meat of the fallen. That doesn't mean it is not a fearsome combatant, eager to add some fresh temple explorers to its otherwise rotting diet.
bossEncounters.name: Rav'i

bossEncounters.description: In the feeding frenzy upon each other, there has been one Child of Ula'tek that has proved victorious over the rest of the brood. With every battle won, the twisting monstrosity known as the Writhing Coil only grows stronger.
bossEncounters.name: The Writhing Coil

bossEncounters.description: With the Fang of Ula'tek, Zul'jan performs the final ritual to gain the power to release the monstrous weapon his ancestors sealed away thousands of years ago. Still held in the sway of the spirit of Malacrass, Zul'jan is unaware that the Fang is also the only hope for his sister Zul'jarra's survival.
bossEncounters.name: Zul'jan

dungeon.description: Upon the Altar of Fangs, the ancient Amani sealed the vaults of Atal'Utek with the Fang of Ula'tek. Only that cursed dagger has the power to unseal the prison of the great weapon of the Amani. Aid Orweyna and Liadrin in their pursuit of Zul'jan, who has entered this accursed place in a misbegotten attempt to bring lost glory back to the Amani.
dungeon.name: Altar of Fangs

bossEncounters.description: Although an accomplished Magister, Kystia Manaheart was far too devoted to fel magic to give it up entirely. Little wonder she's become a staunch supporter and ally to underground fel smuggling operations in the Row.
bossEncounters.name: Kystia Manaheart

bossEncounters.description: Clever, quick-witted and commanding, Zaen Bladesorrow oversees the shipments of illegal fel artifacts. Those under his command follow his orders to the letter... or pay the price.
bossEncounters.name: Zaen Bladesorrow

bossEncounters.description: Xathuux the Annihilator is one of Lithiel Cinderfury's most powerful summons. Although he loathes serving the warlock, he follows her commands for the sheer visceral joy of destruction.
bossEncounters.name: Xathuux the Annihilator

bossEncounters.description: Lithiel Cinderfury sees the Voidstorm above Silvermoon as both threat and opportunity. Her people are afraid, and she has a perfect solution... the power of fel. She claims her smuggling operation protects her people from the dangers above, but the profits she receives are a pleasing bonus.
bossEncounters.name: Lithiel Cinderfury

dungeon.description: The darkened streets of Murder Row hide a secret fel-smuggling operation that has been preying on the fears of Silvermoon's citizens ever since the Voidstorm appeared.
dungeon.name: Murder Row

bossEncounters.description: Driven by voracious greed, the gluttonous Hoardmonger fiercely defends the stashes of food and supplies he has stolen from nearby troll tribes. Nalorakk's first trial is to eliminate him before the tribes go hungry.
bossEncounters.name: The Hoardmonger

bossEncounters.description: The seasons can be kind or cruel. Sentinel of Winter unleashes the harshest of winter storms to test all who face him. To surpass Nalorakk's second trial, endure the biting cold and defeat the embodiment of a winter storm.
bossEncounters.name: Sentinel of Winter

bossEncounters.description: Slumbering in his fitful and battle-filled dream, Nalorakk, the Loa of War, will only test the mettle of the worthy. Survive his trial and receive his blessing or die trying.
bossEncounters.name: Nalorakk

dungeon.description: Wounded by Zul'jin and Malacrass, Nalorakk turned his back on the Amani, slumbering in his den to ease his pain. Now, the Amani seek to heal the rift between their tribe and the loa. But, to gain Nalorakk's favor, those who come before him must complete his trials. Assist Zul'jarra as she journeys into the mind of the Loa of War to defeat him and gain his blessing.
dungeon.name: Den of Nalorakk

bossEncounters.description: The domanaar's prized champion, Taz'Rah, is forced to fight against his will. Taz'Rah demands his own death from every opponent, hoping each battle will finally end his suffering.
bossEncounters.name: Taz'Rah

bossEncounters.description: Imprisoned by Charonus, this starving behemoth is hoping for a new victim to sate his appetite. Atroxus's sheer size is almost as dangerous as the poison he spews.
bossEncounters.name: Atroxus

bossEncounters.description: The overly confident and ostentatious owner of the Voidscar Arena, Charonus, is impressed by the fighting ability of Azerothians and demands them for his grand collection.
bossEncounters.name: Charonus

dungeon.description: The Voidscar Arena awaits worthy challengers! Overseer Charonus has filled the arena with opponents plucked from across Azeroth, forcing them to participate in his games.
dungeon.name: Voidscar Arena

bossEncounters.description: The Lightbloom has suffered a terrible defeat, but like the rutaani it imbues, it changes. These Lightblossomed rutaani fanatically propagate their vicious and invasive garden.
bossEncounters.name: Lightblossom Trinity

bossEncounters.description: Ikuzz is a fearsome carnivore who once stalked prey throughout Harandar. Now the Light Hunter has succumbed to the overwhelming power of the Lightbloom, and his insatiable hunger serves its growth.
bossEncounters.name: Ikuzz the Light Hunter

bossEncounters.description: The once-respected Rootwarden Ruia could not defeat the Lightbloom on his own. His wounded pride led him to drawing power from the Lightbloom and using it to punish all others instead of aiding his allies.
bossEncounters.name: Lightwarden Ruia

bossEncounters.description: Born from the Lightbloom's epicenter, Ziekket was spawned and incubated by Light-infested rutaani to create an unstoppable engine of the Lightbloom's expansion.
bossEncounters.name: Ziekket

dungeon.description:
The Blinding Vale sprouted instantly. From within the Lightbloom, rutaani emerged and spread the Lightbloom in their wake.
After the Lightbloom's defeat in Eversong, Orweyna began surgical strikes to keep the Lightbloom in check. But the hideous glare of the Blinding Vale hides a garden where the Lightbloom cultivates new creatures and magic to drive forward their one fanatical imperative. Growth unstoppable.
dungeon.name: The Blinding Vale

bossEncounters.description: Melidrussa Chillworn leads the Primalist infusion efforts in the Ruby Life Pools. Her fervent belief is that she is protecting young dragon eggs from the influence of the titans and cleansing them from the stain of Order magic. She will stop at nothing to fulfill her calling and return the eggs to what she believes is their natural state.
bossEncounters.name: Melidrussa Chillworn

bossEncounters.description: As Primalist forces assault the Ruby Life Pools from all sides, it falls to Kokia and her Blazebound lieutenants to capture precious eggs from overwhelmed defenders, all while spreading flame and havoc as they go.
bossEncounters.name: Kokia Blazehoof

bossEncounters.description: Kyrakka and Erkhart roam the skies above the Ruby Life Pools coordinating attacks on the shrine below, while also taking out any interfering dragons. If left unchecked, they will burn the Life Pools to the ground and blow the remaining ash away in a cleansing elemental storm.
bossEncounters.name: Kyrakka and Erkhart Stormvein

dungeon.description:
As the ancestral nesting grounds for the five flights, the Ruby Life Pools is a sacred place. The Red Dragonflight, whose charge it is to nuture all life, protect these pools and the the future of all dragonkind held within them.

However, Raszageth and her Primalists have come to steal that future away and infuse their own powers into the sacred pools. They must be stopped for dragonkind to thrive.
dungeon.name: Ruby Life Pools

bossEncounters.description: A pair of powerful sethrak that are blessed by the storm and charged with guarding the temple's entrance.
bossEncounters.name: Adderis and Aspix

bossEncounters.description: Merektha is the product of foul experiments to produce an army of unstoppable beasts. With her clutch of eggs beginning to hatch, this mother is on the hunt for victims to serve as food for her ravenous children.
bossEncounters.name: Merektha

bossEncounters.description: With the corruption of her temple, Sethraliss' command of lightning has created twisted elementals that roam the sunken chambers. Formed by this aberrant energy, Galvazzt seeks to grow in power by any means.
bossEncounters.name: Galvazzt

bossEncounters.description: The Heart of Sethraliss is in the grips of a terrible power that seeks to corrupt her. Her avatar must be restored before this evil takes root and she is reborn as a dark loa capable of destroying the whole of Vol'dun.
bossEncounters.name: Avatar of Sethraliss

dungeon.description: Centuries ago, Sethraliss, a powerful snake loa, sacrificed herself to stop Mythrax from unleashing his master upon Azeroth. After the battle, her devoted followers transported her remains and built a temple around them while they awaited her rebirth. Now, a dark force stirs within this sacred temple that seeks to twist her power towards nefarious ends.
dungeon.name: Temple of Sethraliss

bossEncounters.description: Kings' Rest has come under attack before. After a foolish troll tried to summon Hakkar the Soulflayer to this island many millennia ago, the priests of Zandalar created a mighty construct to defend this tomb. The Golden Serpent has stood against intruders ever since, judging who is worthy to enter these sacred halls.
bossEncounters.name: The Golden Serpent

bossEncounters.description: There was once a caste of Zandalari whose purpose was to preserve and defend the remains of past rulers. But when a terrible plague of corrupted blood tore through the empire, it was too risky for mortals to handle the dead. Golems were summoned for the grim work of preservation and burial; they have been used ever since.
bossEncounters.name: Mchimba the Embalmer

bossEncounters.description: There was once a time when no single emperor could rule Zandalar. After a period of civil war, the heads of three families formed an uneasy coalition and tried to rule the empire together. Though they did not often agree, there was peace in Zandalar. Briefly.
bossEncounters.name: The Council of Tribes

bossEncounters.description:
Dazar. The founder and first King of Zandalar, who led an exodus of his people out of the muck and mire and built a city of gold. The first tamer of raptors. The warrior undefeated. The father of a kingdom.

His eternal repose cut short by Zul's dark magic, it lies to you to once again put him to rest.
bossEncounters.name: Dazar, The First King

dungeon.description:
Few places in Zandalar are more sacred than Kings' Rest. Every king, conqueror, or tyrant who has held control of the Zandalari empire is housed within this great city of the dead to protect and honor not only their bodies, but also their spirits.

Entry has historically been restricted solely to the Zandalari priesthood and royalty, but as Zul's dark magic winds its way through the tomb you must venture inside and put an end to the darkness that has found purchase there.
dungeon.name: Kings' Rest
